mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 5d SPX return is not significantly negative (p>0.05) when UNRATE rises >0.3pp in 1 month over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 60d SPX return is not significantly negative (p>0.05) when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals supply-side weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during supply-constrained regimes.
failure_condition: Average 20d SPX return is not significantly negative (p>0.05) when INDPRO < 105.0 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 5d SPX return is not significantly negative (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate (UNRATE) rise and payroll decline (PAYEMS) indicate severe labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 60d SPX return is not significantly negative (p>0.05) when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines in the same month over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Low industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weak supply-side activity, associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days in any macro regime.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 5d SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high housing market regimes (HOUST > 2500), a retail sales decline (RSAFS) signals consumer demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 60d SPX return is not significantly negative (p>0.05) when HOUST > 2500 and RSAFS declines over 3-year rolling windows.
